What is a summary?
A summary is a short overview of the

words.

Mental Well-being and Cognitive Function
Exercise is not just beneficial for the body but also for the mind. Engaging in physical activity
releases endorphins, commonly known as "feel-good" hormones, which help reduce stress,
anxiety, and depression. Regular exercise is linked to improved mood and increased self-
esteem, as it provides a sense of accomplishment and promotes a positive body image.
Furthermore, physical activity has been shown to enhance cognitive function, memory
retention, and overall brain health. It can sharpen focus, boost creativity, and improve
productivity, making exercise an essential component of a healthy lifestyle.
Social Connections and Emotional Resilience
Exercise serves as a powerful catalyst for forging social connections and nurturing emotional
resilience. Participating in group activities, team sports, or fitness classes not only Offers the
opportunity to meet like-minded individuals but also fosters a sense Of belonging and
camaraderie. The shared goals, challenges, and triumphs experienced during exercise can build
lasting friendships and support networks. Moreover, physical activity acts as a natural stress
reliever, helping individuals develop emotional resilience and cope better with life's ups and
downs.
Make it A Daily Routine
Incorporating exercise into our daily routines holds immense transformative power,
revolutionizing both our bodies and minds. The myriad benefits of exercise encompass
improved physical health, enhanced mental well-being, and strengthened emotional resilience.
By making a commitrnent to regular physical activity, we take an active step towards a healthier
and more fulfilling life, so let's embrace the transformative power Of allowing it to
uplift our spirits, energize our bodies, and pave tt•æ way to a brighter future.

Main Points
• Since a summary is about the overall main points of the article, we should take
information from each paragraph to summarize the article.
• Firstly, do not take information from the introduction paragraph or the concluding
paragraph.
• Focus only on the body paragraphs.
• Make sure that the sentence you pick summarizes the overall idea of that particular
paragraph. (They are usually the topic sentence).
• Topic sentences are the overall summary of the paragraph.

• A: Introduction Paragraph
• B: Body Paragraph #1
• C: Body Paragraph #2
• D: Body Paragraph #3
• E: Conclusion Paragraph

How to begin the paragraph?
• When you begin the paragraph, you must first let the readers know that it is a
summary by using signal words.
• You have to make it clear to the reader that the information they are about to read
came from an article, but is information that is being given is written in your own
words.
• You have let us know the name of the article (if given), the name of the author (if
given), the name of the source (if given), and the author’s thesis in your own words.
• There are several ways to do this, but we will show you the 3 easiest ways to write
the first sentence.

First Sentence Method #1
According to the article, “The Transformative Power of Exercise: Elevating
Body and Mind,” written by Lorenzo Von Matterhorn, exercising is beneficial
in a number of ways that make people’s lives greater whether it’s going to the
fitness center, jogging, playing in teams sports, or just simple yoga.
According to the article, “(Insert the title of the article),” written by (Name of the author), (paraphrased version of the author’s thesis).

First Sentence Method #2
Based on Lorenzo Von Matterhorn’s article, “The Transformative Power of
Exercise: Elevating Body and Mind,” he states that exercising is beneficial in a
number of ways that make people’s lives greater whether it’s going to the fitness center,
jogging, playing in teams sports, or just simple yoga.
Based on (Author’s name)’s article, “(Title of the article),” he/she states that (Paraphrased version of the thesis).

First Sentence Method #3
Lorenzo Von Matterhorn, who is the author of the article, “The Transformative
Power of Exercise: Elevating Body and Mind,” states that exercising is beneficial in a
number of ways that make people’s lives greater whether it’s going to the fitness center,
jogging, playing in teams sports, or just simple yoga.
(Name of the author), who is the author of the article, “(The title of the article),” states that (paraphrased version of the thesis).
